title: Add Graceful Shutdown & Health‑Check Endpoint
description: Provides a /health endpoint for load‑balancers and implements graceful shutdown of the HTTP server to finish in‑flight requests before process exit. This improves reliability in production and reduces dropped requests during deployments or crashes.
testCases: Verify GET /health returns 200 with {status:"ok"} JSON payload
Simulate SIGTERM and ensure server stops accepting new connections but resolves existing request before process exits
acceptance:
- /health endpoint returns HTTP 200 and JSON {status:"ok"}
- When SIGTERM is sent, server logs "shutting down", stops accepting new connections, waits up to 30 s for active requests, then exits with code 0
reason: Load‑balancers need a reliable health check and production deployments require zero‑downtime restarts. Implementing graceful shutdown prevents request loss and aligns yantraverse with enterprise‑grade expectations.
